> Full stack developer in Istanbul, Turkey. Writing software professionally since
> 2018. I build and run production systems on .NET and React, from database design
> and query tuning to front ends and deployment. Contact: contact@eguven.dev

This file follows the llms.txt convention: a short, plain text summary of a site for
language models. A longer machine formatted version of the same information, with the
numbers and the source links, is at https://eguven.dev/ai

## Who

- Name: Emirhan Guven (Emirhan Güven)
- Role: Full stack developer, .NET and React

- Languages: Turkish (native), English (professional working proficiency)
- Education: Istanbul Aydin University, associate degree in computer programming
- Email: contact@eguven.dev

## Stack

- Backend: C#, .NET 8, .NET 9, ASP.NET Core, Web API, Entity Framework Core, LINQ, Python, PHP
- Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Blazor
- Databases: PostgreSQL (Npgsql, EF Core), DuckDB, Redis, MySQL. Familiar with SQL Server.
- Desktop: Photino.NET with Blazor, Electron
- Infrastructure: Docker, Docker Compose, Traefik, Let's Encrypt, GitHub Actions, Nginx,
  PowerDNS, Linux server administration (Hetzner)
- Testing: NUnit. Also SignalR, Serilog, JWT and BCrypt auth.
- AI: Anthropic API, OpenAI API, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers

## Main work

CRMSolid (2025 to present). Own product, in production, paying users. A multi-tenant
SaaS CRM I designed, wrote and still operate on my own. It is a modular monolith, not
microservices, and it ships as 5 separately deployed pieces: REST API, admin panel,
desktop agent, health monitor and landing site. PostgreSQL with EF Core, 40+ entities,
30+ API controllers, 516 NUnit test methods across 34 test files. Real time updates
with SignalR, caching with Redis, structured logging with Serilog, auth with JWT and
BCrypt. Runs on Docker Compose on a Hetzner server behind Traefik with automatic
Let's Encrypt SSL, deployed by GitHub Actions over key based SSH.

Inside CRMSolid: a business directory built from Overture Maps open data with DuckDB,
1.79 million records loaded into PostgreSQL, main lookup query cut from 277 seconds to
15 milliseconds. An MCP server that lets AI assistants read and write CRM data through
defined tools and prompts, with its own test suite. AI lead scoring on the Anthropic
and OpenAI APIs. A desktop agent built with Photino.NET and Blazor on .NET 9, plus an
Electron build, that manages 16+ communication channels.

NerioPanel (2025 to 2026). Multi-tenant SaaS platform on .NET 8 and React. White label
hosting so resellers run branded panels on their own domains. One shared database with
row level security per tenant, and a PowerDNS and Nginx layer that issues SSL
certificates and routes reseller domains automatically.

Evelynn (2019 to 2021). Multi-session desktop automation agent in C#, built on TPL and
async/await. Runs 20+ sessions at once on one machine with controlled memory use. Per
session rate limiting and spread out request timing keep the workload inside each
service's published limits. Web dashboard for live telemetry and remote control.

Earlier: Irul Media and Lovisoft (2024 to 2025), marketing and e-commerce sites at
around 10,000 API calls a day, server load cut by about 40% on a legacy PHP and MySQL
stack with Redis query caching and missing database indexes, plus an order pipeline
connected to 5 payment and service providers. Freelance before that, from 2018.

measured it is not here: there is no uptime figure on this site, because uptime is not
